golden-hour-artist.name: Mieraf Girum
golden-hour-artist.bio: Addis Ababa painter of warm, light-filled portraits. Her Golden Hour series turns the last minutes of sunset into living art that moves when you look at it.

mignon.name: Abraham Mignon (demo)
mignon.bio: Demo listing. Dutch Golden Age still-life painter known for lush flower pieces full of hidden insects and dewdrops.

audubon.name: John James Audubon (demo)
audubon.bio: Demo listing. Naturalist painter whose life-size bird plates combine scientific detail with movement.

studio-color.name: Color Study Studio (demo)
studio-color.bio: Demo listing. Loose, bright watercolour studies of shape and colour.

studio-land.name: Landscape Archive (demo)
studio-land.bio: Demo listing. Classic watercolour landscapes of cliffs, paths and open skies.

listings.title: Golden Hour
listings.description: A woman in the last warm light of the day, wrapped in drifting cloth beneath twin suns. Archival print on heavy matte paper.

listings.title: Flowers in a Vase
listings.description: A dark, glowing still life: striped tulips, roses, poppies and an iris spill from a bronze vase, with butterflies, snails and a dragonfly hidden among the stems.

listings.title: Color Study
listings.description: Loose watercolour shapes in deep blue, plum, green, pink and orange, overlapping like a quiet landscape.

listings.title: Mountain Pass
listings.description: Pale cliffs rise above an autumn path winding through russet trees, under a soft summer sky.

listings.title: Thrushes on Mistletoe
listings.description: Three thrushes in rust, slate and brown perch and tumble through a sprig of mistletoe, painted with naturalist detail.
